items.s: Swipe through three intro screens, then answer one page each for your details, your main focus and experience, and your training goal, and you're ready to log. A main focus that includes strength has one more page.
p: Swipe through the three intro screens and tap Get started on the last one.
On the <q class="say">Tell us about you</q> page, enter your nickname, sex, birth year, height, and weight in one go. For birth year, height, and weight, tap the row to choose.

At What do you mostly train?, pick Mostly strength, Strength and running, or Mostly running, then choose how much training you've done further down the same page (running experience for Mostly running). If your main focus includes running and you've run before, you can also enter a recent running result below that, or leave it blank. Main focus only sets what shows first; every strength and running feature stays available, and you can change it later in Main focus.

Pick your training goal. Goals closest to your main focus come first, and above the list you see the defaults for the goal you picked (Program goal, Program cardio, and Diet). Mostly running ends here.

A main focus that includes strength has one more page. If you chose Just starting, pick where you train and how many times a week (and Not available here if it's a gym), and you get a first routine that fits your goal. If you've trained before, enter your estimated squat 1RM, or tap Not sure or Estimate from a lift if you don't know it.
